predecessors.name: Qing dynasty
predecessors.text: the Tarim Basin, from which 'the Chinese were expelled from the region in 1864'

successors.name: Qing dynasty
successors.text: the Qing army 'entered Kashgar and brought the state to an end' on 18 December 1877; Xinjiang became a province in 1884

ledger.x: 1866: the rest of the Tarim Basin is brought in.

wars.name: Qing reconquest of Xinjiang
wars.outcome: Zuo Zongtang's army ended Yettishar; Kashgar entered on 18 December 1877; Xinjiang became a province in 1884.

wars.name: Dungan Revolt (1862-1877)
wars.outcome: The risings of 1864 (Kucha, Urumqi, Yarkand, Ili) broke Qing rule in Xinjiang; Yakub Beg built Yettishar on them and the Qing reconquered it by December 1877.

certainty.note: An oasis state without surveyed frontiers; Tarim, Taklamakan and Tian Shan edges are approximate.
